# Troubleshooting

## When to use this guide

A `corelink` invocation is failing with a non-zero exit code, hanging, or
returning unexpected JSON. The eight `doctor` checks below cover every
known failure class.

## Run the doctor

```bash
corelink doctor --json | jq
```

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "subcommand": "doctor",
  "checks": [
    { "name": "network",        "status": "ok"   },
    { "name": "auth",           "status": "ok"   },
    { "name": "storage_write",  "status": "ok"   },
    { "name": "storage_read",   "status": "ok"   },
    { "name": "byok",           "status": "skip" },
    { "name": "region",         "status": "ok"   },
    { "name": "quota",          "status": "warn", "next_action_doc": "docs/reference/error-taxonomy#COR_QUOTA_001" },
    { "name": "client_verify",  "status": "ok"   }
  ]
}
```

Every non-`ok` check carries a `next_action_doc` URL pointing at the
canonical fix in `docs/reference/error-taxonomy`.

## Common exit codes

| Exit | Meaning | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| `1` | Generic failure | `corelink doctor --json` |
| `2` | Argument error or `--pat` flag rejected | Re-read [01-authenticate](./01-authenticate.mdx) |
| `3` | Verify mismatch (`COR_VERIFY_001`) | Retry; if persistent open Sev-2 |
| `4` | Not found (`COR_CAS_NOT_FOUND`) | Confirm digest with `corelink stat` |
| `5` | Rate limit (`COR_QUOTA_RATELIMIT`) | Back off + retry |

## Hanging commands

Set a hard timeout:

```bash
timeout 30s corelink get <digest>
```

If the binary hangs at startup, run with `RUST_LOG=debug` and capture
stderr.

## Verbose logging

```bash
RUST_LOG=debug corelink ls --tenant acme-corp 2>logs.json
jq 'select(.level=="ERROR")' logs.json
```

## Reporting a bug

Attach:
1. `corelink version --output json`
2. `corelink doctor --output json`
3. The failing command + `RUST_LOG=debug` stderr.

Never attach your PAT.
